scripts.build:editor: pnpm typecheck && vite build --mode editor --config app/client/vite.config.ts
scripts.format: oxfmt --write package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml .oxlintrc.json tsconfig.json playwright.config.ts .devcontainer .github app infra dashboard tests
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml .oxlintrc.json tsconfig.json playwright.config.ts .devcontainer .github app infra dashboard tests
scripts.typecheck: pnpm prepare:pyodide && tsc -p app/shared/schema && tsc -p app/shared/utils && tsc -p app/shared/lib && tsc -p app/shared/vite && tsc -p app/client && tsc -p app/server/packages/exporter && tsc -p app/server && tsc -p infra && tsc -p infra/cdk && tsc -p tests
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck
